test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient/necessary to answer the question.

**Question:**

How many workers are there in a factory?

**Statements:**

I. There are more than 30 but less than 37 workers in the factory.

II. There are more than 34 but less than 41 workers in the factory. The number of workers in the factory can be divided into two groups in such a manner that each group contains an equal number of workers.

options.text: Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question
Both statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question

solution:
Data sufficiency can be dealt in the following ways:

 
• Two statements are provided which will help in determining whether the question can be answered or not. 
 
• If only one statement\(individually) can help in answering the question, then the answer will be chosen from option 2 or option 4.
 
• Then, we will check whether both statements together are required to solve the question, choose option 3, otherwise option 1. 

**Explanation:**

**Statement I:**

 
• There are more than 30 but less than 37 workers in the factory.​​
